# openfga

OpenFGA authorization service for CAIPE relationship-based access control

| | |
|---|---|
| **Version** | `1.0.0` |
| **Type** | application |

## Quick Start

```bash
# Add and install the chart
helm install openfga oci://ghcr.io/caipe-io/charts/openfga --version 1.0.0

# Upgrade an existing release
helm upgrade openfga oci://ghcr.io/caipe-io/charts/openfga --version 1.0.0
```

## Customizing Values

Override default values using `--set` flags or a custom values file:

```bash
# Override individual values
helm install openfga oci://ghcr.io/caipe-io/charts/openfga --version 1.0.0 \
  --set replicaCount=2

# Use a custom values file
helm install openfga oci://ghcr.io/caipe-io/charts/openfga --version 1.0.0 \
  -f custom-values.yaml

# Show all configurable values
helm show values oci://ghcr.io/caipe-io/charts/openfga --version 1.0.0
```
